name: confirmed_continuation
title: Confirmed Continuation · Подтверждённое продолжение тренда
description: Narrow bidirectional continuation strategy. LONG: higher_low_retest_continuation_long — confirmed rising trend continuation after a controlled pullback/retest. SHORT: lower_high_retest_continuation_short — confirmed falling trend continuation after a controlled bounce/retest. Does NOT catch bottoms, tops, first bounces, or blowoff moves. Environment-neutral signal producer — Bot owns execution mode.
